title: tropicaland
description: A vanilla-inspired adventure modpack that expands Minecraft with structures, mobs, combat, exploration, and quality-of-life improvements. NOT Tropical themed.
body:
Explore overhauled terrain generation with Geophilic and additional world generation mods, discover new dungeons and structures scattered throughout the world, and encounter new creatures from mods such as The Aether, Ecologics, Guard Villagers, and Illager Invasion.

The pack also includes a variety of quality-of-life improvements and performance optimizations to provide a smoother gameplay experience without changing the game's identity.

Features include:

Expanded world generation with new biomes and terrain improvements
New structures, dungeons, and points of interest
Additional mobs, enemies, and friendly creatures
Improved combat and equipment progression
Farming, cooking, and decorative content
Quality-of-life improvements and performance enhancements
Multiplayer support

Tropicaland is designed for players who want a larger, more adventurous Minecraft experience while keeping the familiar vanilla atmosphere intact.
